correctness.rationale: Starting from the stated closed formula C=a(A(r)-B(r)log r), where a=min(k,l), r=max(k,l)/a>1, A=r(r+1)/(r-1)^2 and B=2r²/(r-1)^3, equality of two coefficients yields q=αlog r−βlog s with q,α,β rational and α,β positive. Multiplication by a common denominator gives integer Q=m log r−n log s, so e^Q=r^m/s^n is rational. Hermite–Lindemann forbids any nonzero integer Q; thus q=0 and the rational and logarithmic parts agree separately. Their quotient gives h(log r)=h(log s) with h(x)=x/sinh x, strictly decreasing on x>0, hence r=s, then a=c and b=d. Independent algebra confirmed B/A=1/sinh(log r) and representative coefficient integrals. Finite high-precision stress testing is not used as infinite proof. The conclusion is exact, not stable numerical inversion.
